prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original wide landscape game-store cover illustration, 16:9, full bleed, opaque, no UI.
Primary request: an elegant miniature winter-skiing diorama for a simple motion-controlled family game. One stylized adult skier moves forward by swinging their arms and gently steers between lateral obstacles.
Scene: a winding snow trail through a quiet miniature evergreen forest, with a few clearly readable snowbanks and rounded rocks beside the trail. The trail flows from the foreground toward a pale blue distant ridge.
Subject: one small but expressive skier in an amber jacket, charcoal trousers, dark skis and simple gloves, captured mid arm-pump with balanced bent knees. Emphasize playful forward movement and a clear open path, not an extreme stunt.
Style/medium: sophisticated handmade 3D paper-and-clay illustration, crisply layered cut-paper shapes, softly rounded low-poly forms, matte materials, delicate visible paper fibers only at close range. A polished consumer game illustration with restrained art direction, not a screenshot.
Composition/framing: wide cinematic landscape; three-quarter elevated camera; skier prominent just left of center; layered foreground branches create depth while all essential action remains inside the central 75 percent. Crisp silhouettes at thumbnail size. Artwork fills the rectangular frame with no card border.
Lighting/mood: soft winter daylight, warm side light, broad gentle contact shadows, inviting and quietly energetic.
Color palette: icy powder blue and paper white snow, deep pine teal, warm amber accent, a little graphite.
Constraints: only one player; no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, badges, scores, health metrics, controllers, camera, screen, interface, split panels or surrounding mockup.
provenance: Original generated illustration. No household data, photographs or game screenshots were used.
presentation: Illustrative cover art; not a screenshot, performance claim, or representation of final game visual fidelity.
